# UI Requirements for Safaricom Daraja API Frontend

## Overview

Build a modern, responsive web application using Next.js to consume the Django backend APIs for Safaricom's Daraja M-Pesa integration. The UI should provide an intuitive interface for developers and businesses to test, manage, and monitor M-Pesa transactions.

## Objectives

- Create a user-friendly dashboard for interacting with all Daraja API endpoints
- Implement real-time transaction status updates
- Provide comprehensive transaction history and analytics
- Ensure secure and reliable API consumption
- Deliver a professional UI inspired by Next.js design principles

## Design Guidelines

### Theme Inspiration: Next.js Style
- **Clean and Minimalist**: Use ample white space, subtle shadows, and clean typography
- **Modern Aesthetics**: Rounded corners, smooth animations, and a professional color palette
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with adaptive layouts
- **Dark/Light Mode**: Toggle between themes for user preference
- **Accessibility**: WCAG compliant with proper contrast ratios and keyboard navigation

### Color Palette
- Primary: Next.js inspired blues (#0070f3, #0051cc)
- Secondary: Neutral grays (#f8f9fa, #e9ecef, #6c757d)
- Success: Green (#28a745)
- Warning: Orange (#ffc107)
- Error: Red (#dc3545)
- Background: White (#ffffff) / Dark (#1a1a1a)

### Typography
- Font Family: Inter or similar system font stack
- Headings: Bold, 1.5-2rem
- Body: Regular, 1rem with 1.6 line height

## Core Features

### 1. Dashboard Overview
- **Transaction Summary Cards**: Display counts of successful, pending, and failed transactions
- **Recent Transactions Table**: Show latest 10 transactions with status indicators
- **Quick Actions Panel**: Shortcuts to initiate common operations (STK Push, B2C, etc.)

### 2. STK Push (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online)
- **Initiate Payment Form**:
  - Phone number input with validation
  - Amount input with currency formatting
  - Account reference and transaction description fields
  - Real-time form validation
- **Payment Status Page**:
  - QR code display for mobile scanning
  - Real-time status polling with progress indicator
  - Success/failure notifications
- **Query Status Tool**: Manual status check by Checkout Request ID

### 3. B2C (Business to Customer) Payments
- **Payment Form**:
  - Recipient phone number
  - Amount and reason for payment
  - Command ID selection (SalaryPayment, BusinessPaymentToUser, etc.)
- **Bulk Payment Interface**: Upload CSV for multiple payments
- **Payment Queue**: Show pending and completed B2C transactions

### 4. B2B (Business to Business) Payments
- **Payment Form**:
  - Receiver party details (shortcode/paybill)
  - Amount and account reference
  - Command ID selection
- **Payment History**: Filterable list of B2B transactions

### 5. C2B (Customer to Business) Management
- **URL Registration Tool**: Register validation and confirmation URLs
- **Transaction Monitoring**: Real-time display of incoming C2B payments
- **Callback Logs**: View and filter callback notifications

### 6. Transaction Management
- **Transaction Search**: Advanced filtering by date, amount, status, type
- **Detailed Transaction View**: Complete transaction information with callback data
- **Export Functionality**: Download transaction reports as CSV/PDF
- **Reversal Interface**: Request transaction reversals with reason

### 7. Account & Balance
- **Balance Inquiry**: Query and display account balance
- **Balance History**: Track balance changes over time

### 8. Analytics & Reporting
- **Transaction Analytics**: Charts showing transaction volumes, success rates
- **Revenue Reports**: Monthly/yearly summaries
- **Error Analysis**: Common failure reasons and trends

### 9. Settings & Configuration
- **API Configuration**: Display current Daraja settings (masked for security)
- **Callback URL Management**: View and update registered URLs
- **Environment Toggle**: Switch between sandbox and production modes

## Technical Requirements

### Frontend Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 14+ with App Router
- **Language**: TypeScript for type safety
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling
- **State Management**: React Context or Zustand for global state
- **API Client**: Axios or Fetch with interceptors for authentication
- **Forms**: React Hook Form with validation
- **Charts**: Recharts or similar for data visualization

### API Integration
- **Base URL**: Connect to Django backend at `/api/mpesa/`
- **Authentication**: Handle CORS and any required headers
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error states with user-friendly messages
- **Real-time Updates**: Implement polling or WebSockets for status updates
- **Rate Limiting**: Handle API rate limits gracefully

### Performance & Security
- **Loading States**: Skeleton loaders and progress indicators
- **Caching**: Implement appropriate caching for static data
- **Security**: Never expose API keys; use environment variables
- **Validation**: Client-side and server-side validation
- **Error Boundaries**: Graceful error handling at component level

## User Experience Requirements

### Navigation
- **Sidebar Navigation**: Collapsible sidebar with main sections
- **Breadcrumb Navigation**: Clear indication of current page location
- **Search Bar**: Global search for transactions and operations

### Responsiveness
- **Mobile Optimized**: Touch-friendly interfaces for mobile devices
- **Tablet Support**: Adaptive layouts for tablet screens
- **Desktop Enhancement**: Utilize screen real estate effectively

### Accessibility
- **Keyboard Navigation**: Full keyboard accessibility
- **Screen Reader Support**: Proper ARIA labels and semantic HTML
- **Color Contrast**: Meet WCAG AA standards
- **Focus Management**: Clear focus indicators

## Acceptance Criteria

### Functional Requirements
- [ ] All major API endpoints have corresponding UI components
- [ ] Real-time status updates for initiated transactions
- [ ] Comprehensive transaction history with filtering
- [ ] Secure handling of sensitive payment data
- [ ] Export functionality for reports

### Design Requirements
- [ ] UI matches Next.js inspired design language
- [ ] Fully responsive across all device sizes
- [ ] Dark/light mode toggle functionality
- [ ] Consistent spacing, typography, and color usage

### Technical Requirements
- [ ] TypeScript implementation with proper typing
- [ ] Error handling for all API interactions
- [ ] Loading states and user feedback
- [ ] Code follows Next.js best practices
- [ ] Performance optimized (Lighthouse score >90)

### Testing Requirements
- [ ] Unit tests for components and utilities
- [ ] Integration tests for API interactions
- [ ] End-to-end tests for critical user flows
- [ ] Cross-browser compatibility testing

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 1: Core Infrastructure
- Set up Next.js project with TypeScript and Tailwind
- Implement API client and error handling
- Create basic layout and navigation

### Phase 2: Transaction Management
- Build transaction list and detail views
- Implement search and filtering
- Add export functionality

### Phase 3: Payment Operations
- STK Push interface with real-time updates
- B2C and B2B payment forms
- C2B monitoring and URL registration

### Phase 4: Analytics & Settings
- Dashboard with charts and summaries
- Settings page for configuration
- Advanced reporting features

### Phase 5: Polish & Testing
- UI/UX refinements
- Comprehensive testing
- Performance optimization
- Documentation

## Success Metrics

- **User Satisfaction**: Intuitive interface reducing development time
- **Transaction Success Rate**: >95% successful API interactions
- **Performance**: <2s page load times, <500ms API response times
- **Accessibility**: WCAG AA compliance
- **Maintainability**: Clean, documented code with >80% test coverage
